title: Player enters a score via Score kiosk
description: On the club Score kiosk, players open a match cell, enter set scores, confirm with both participants’ PINs, and save — without an organizer login at the table.

steps.title: Active tournament
steps.body: An organizer opens Tutorial Active Round Robin. Score kiosk locks the terminal to match entry for this event.

steps.title: Start Score kiosk
steps.body: Staff taps Score kiosk once. After that, anyone at the table can record results with participant PINs.

steps.title: Score kiosk mode
steps.body: The grid stays on this tournament. Players use Enter score on empty cells — no personal login.
steps.resultNote: Tournament score kiosk is active (Restore privileges visible).

steps.title: Open a match
steps.body: Tap an empty match cell for the two players who just finished.

steps.title: Match Entry with PINs
steps.body: In kiosk mode the dialog requires both participants’ score PINs before a result can be saved.
steps.resultNote: Match Entry popup shows score fields and Participant PINs.

steps.title: Enter score and both PINs
steps.body: Type the set counts (here 3–1), each player’s PIN (same demo PIN for tutorial members), then confirm with the green checkmark.
steps.actionHint: Click the green checkmark to save

steps.title: Score recorded
steps.body: Both PINs accepted: the grid shows the result and the next empty match is ready for the next pair.
steps.resultNote: Match saved from Score kiosk with participant PINs.
